Container.Name: supertonic3-tts-german-wyoming
Container.Overview: Local German Home Assistant TTS using Rust, Supertonic 3, CPU ONNX and native Wyoming. 44100 Hz mono PCM16. First start downloads persistent official models/voices. Phrase streaming is optional and may alter prosody; full synthesis remains available. Mount ownership must allow UID 99/GID 100. Prepared locally; image/icon availability requires separate publication.

Config.Name: Wyoming Port
Config.Description: Host Wyoming TCP port; keep container WYOMING_PORT matched

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host health/voice HTTP port; keep container HTTP_PORT matched

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Persistent models, only missing assets downloaded

Config.Name: Voices
Config.Description: Persistent preset/custom voice JSON; restart to discover custom files

Config.Name: Default Voice
Config.Description: Installed voice: F1–F5, M1–M5 or custom JSON filename stem

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: German default; regional German tags map to de

Config.Name: Speed
Config.Description: 0.25–4.0; 1.0 normal speed

Config.Name: Steps
Config.Description: 5–12 inference steps; N100 recommendation 6

Config.Name: Threads
Config.Description: ONNX intra-op threads; N100 recommendation 4

Config.Name: German Normalization
Config.Description: German sensor number/unit normalization before segmentation

Config.Name: Streaming
Config.Description: Optional phrase pipeline; false restores full-context synthesis

Config.Name: Streaming Prefill (ms)
Config.Description: 0–5000 ms; conservative tested setting 3500

Config.Name: Concurrent Requests
Config.Description: Independent engine count; values above one consume more RAM

Config.Name: Model Directory
Config.Description: Keep aligned with persistent container model path

Config.Name: Voice Directory
Config.Description: Keep aligned with persistent container voice path

Config.Name: ORT Configured
Config.Description: Preserve upstream engine unless deliberately tuning

Config.Name: ORT Thread Pool
Config.Description: global or session; legacy wrapper requires global

Config.Name: ORT Inter-op Threads
Config.Description: ONNX inter-op threads

Config.Name: ORT Spinning
Config.Description: Keep disabled for tested N100 configuration

Config.Name: ORT Execution Mode
Config.Description: parallel requires ORT_CONFIGURED=true

Config.Name: Optimized Datapath
Config.Description: Bounded audio conversion and output

Config.Name: Buffered TCP
Config.Description: Buffered writes and TCP_NODELAY

Config.Name: AudioChunk Bytes
Config.Description: Even value from 512 to 262144

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Rust tracing filter

Config.Name: Container Wyoming Port
Config.Description: Match internal target of the Wyoming port mapping

Config.Name: Container HTTP Port
Config.Description: Match internal target of the HTTP port mapping
